description: A Reactome pathway group is a physical component of a containing pathway group. The relationship represents directly curated complex composition, with components present together rather than alternative set membership.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources supporting the relationship; includes Reactome.

common_properties.name: version
common_properties.description: Reactome release number in which the relationship was last seen.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was created or last updated in SPOKE.

source_contributions.scope: Complexes represented in the human BioPAX export within Signaling Pathways (R-HSA-162582), Immune System (R-HSA-168256), and Diseases of signal transduction by growth factor receptors and second messengers (R-HSA-5663202), including descendant pathways. Complexes include those reached from event participants, controllers, and active units, recursively through complex components and set members.
source_contributions.description: Each compartment and modification variant of a complex has its own PwGroup node. A Complex-typed set of alternative complexes can itself be a component of a containing complex, but its alternative members are never linked to the set. Stoichiometry is not represented.
